name: synthetic_10_to_4
notes: signature: downsample_taxa_faith_pd(dist_mat, taxa, max_species) -> (sub_dist_mat, selected_taxa). Farthest-point traversal: start with the argmax pair (np.unravel_index(np.argmax(dist_mat)) i.e. first maximum in row-major order), then repeatedly add argmax of the running min-distance vector (first index on ties). Returns the input unchanged when max_species >= n or <= 0. Selected order is the selection order, not the original order.

name: camelid_128_to_64_hyphy_branch_lengths
notes: signature: downsample_taxa_faith_pd(dist_mat, taxa, max_species) -> (sub_dist_mat, selected_taxa). Farthest-point traversal: start with the argmax pair (np.unravel_index(np.argmax(dist_mat)) i.e. first maximum in row-major order), then repeatedly add argmax of the running min-distance vector (first index on ties). Returns the input unchanged when max_species >= n or <= 0. Selected order is the selection order, not the original order. examples/camelid.nwk has no branch lengths, so load_alignment_and_tree estimated them with HyPhy (HYPHY 2.5.65(MP) for Darwin on x86_64 x86 AVX SIMD with FMA3 zlib (v1.2.12)); the resulting 128x128 matrix is captured here as the INPUT so this case does not depend on HyPhy at replay time. QUIRK replicated: before the Faith's PD step load_alignment_and_tree strides to at most 2*max_species taxa (stride = max(1, n // (2*max_species)) which is 1 for 212 taxa, so it simply keeps the FIRST 128 unique taxa in tree order); sub_dist_mat omitted for size (64x64 of the given input rows/cols), diagonal check only.
